test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rahul and Rohit start running on a circular track (of length 360 m) from the same point simultaneously with a speed of 3 m/s and 4 m/s. After how much time from the start, they will meet again at the starting point?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of circular track = 360 m

Speed of Rahul = 3 m/s

Speed of Rohit = 4 m/s

**Formula used:**

Time for meeting again at the starting point = LCM (Track length / Speed of Rahul, Track length / Speed of Rohit)

**Calculation:**

Time taken by Rahul to complete one round = 360 ÷ 3 = 120 seconds

Time taken by Rohit to complete one round = 360 ÷ 4 = 90 seconds

⇒ LCM of 120 and 90 = 360 seconds

⇒ 360 seconds = 6 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
